title: Glowing umbrella
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='canopy' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF6B6B'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#CC3333'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='canopy2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF8E8E'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E05555'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- canopy left panel -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q30 22 18 40 Q28 36 35 40 Q42 36 50 40 Z' fill='url(#canopy)'/>
  <!-- canopy middle-left panel -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q42 22 35 40 Q42 36 50 40 Z' fill='url(#canopy2)'/>
  <!-- canopy middle-right panel -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q58 22 65 40 Q58 36 50 40 Z' fill='url(#canopy)'/>
  <!-- canopy right panel -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q70 22 82 40 Q72 36 65 40 Q58 36 50 40 Z' fill='url(#canopy2)'/>

  <!-- canopy top highlight -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q35 21 24 36 Q33 30 42 31 Q48 28 50 28 Q52 28 58 31 Q67 30 76 36 Q65 21 50 20 Z' fill='#FFB3B3' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- top tip -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='3' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- ribs -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='22' y2='39' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='78' y2='39' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- shaft -->
  <rect x='48' y='40' width='4' height='38' rx='2' fill='#8B6914'/>
  <rect x='48' y='40' width='2' height='38' rx='1' fill='#B8860B'/>

  <!-- hook handle -->
  <path d='M50 78 Q50 88 42 88 Q36 88 36 82' fill='none' stroke='#B8860B' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 78 Q50 88 42 88 Q36 88 36 82' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- rain drops -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='54' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#66CCFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='58' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#66CCFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='62' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#66CCFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='50' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#66CCFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#66CCFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='72' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#66CCFF' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='20' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
</svg>
